moments.author: Jimmy Jean‑Louis
moments.quote: A HEROES reunion to celebrate the life of HAYDEN was deeply emotional. There was sadness in our hearts, but also so much love, gratitude, and warmth as we remembered the beautiful moments shared and the lasting impact of a life that touched so many. Au revoir Hayden.
moments.why: It went viral because fans were deeply moved seeing the ‘Heroes’ cast reunite to honor Hayden Panettiere, reflecting the enduring impact of the show and her legacy.

moments.author: Stephen Colbert
moments.quote: I think we can all agree that Jimmy Kimmel deserves an Emmy. I don’t care if you’ve never even seen his show, you know he deserves an Emmy. Besides, look how cute he is! Anyway, please consider thinking that Jimmy deserves an Emmy. I do. I love you.
moments.why: It sparked conversation due to the rare and playful moment of Colbert endorsing a fellow nominee even while competing against him, showcasing camaraderie and humor amid awards season.

moments.author: Oprah Winfrey
moments.quote: No one like her. She brought the light, and we are all better because she was here.
moments.why: It resonated widely as a heartfelt, succinct tribute from a beloved public figure to Dolly Parton, capturing the emotional weight of her passing.
